evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Jeline: 'this might take ten to fifteen minutes. So is this a good time to talk about your move?' — framing present but no explicit 'dependable quote' promise and no real wait for yes; customer says 'Sure, yeah' immediately but rep proceeds without a true confirmation pause
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Jeline confirms pickup address (14706 Rider gray drive), moving day (October 9th), confirms destination (14100 John Henry phone drive), establishes 1600 sq ft two-story townhome with 3 bedrooms and 3-bedroom destination — all four basics covered
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathers property type (townhome), stories (2 story pickup / 3 story destination), bedrooms (3), garage (2-car, accessible), parking (behind garage at both ends), special items (two 75-inch TVs, furniture inventory), access (flat, no trees, no inclines) — comprehensive logistics probing
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Jeline: 'normally for a 1600 square feet house, we see it fifty to sixty boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' — box count anchor and range offered, customer confirms ~60 boxes total
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Jeline: 'for a 1600 square feet house we finish the move-in eight and a half hours... I estimate fifth to finish in seven and a half to eight and a half hours with three movers and one truck. So the estimated cost for your move is between $2,590 to $2,920.' — range given with hourly breakdown and personalized to the two 75-inch TVs, two-story pickup, three-story destination, and drive time considerations
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Jeline: '$110 per hour per mover... $115 travel fee... no hidden fees... minimum of two and a half hour after that minimum the time is prorated in fifteen minute increments... if the move will take less than this, then you will only be charged for how much time we used' — full disclosure of trip fee, hourly rate, minimum, increments, and not-a-guess framing all present
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: No 'does that feel fair?' question asked; customer instead asks 'are you able to just send me that estimate?' — rep pivots directly to email without a pause for customer reaction to pricing
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jeline never asked 'other than price, what are your biggest concerns?' or equivalent; jumped directly into logistics probing with property/room questions
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — no concerns were raised by the customer during the call, so no follow-up opportunity existed
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no concerns were raised, so no reflection was needed
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asked 'what's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine final concerns check; call ends with customer saying 'alright, thank you so much' and rep saying 'Enjoy the rest of your day, bye-bye'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked; no 'anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' question
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'would you like our help with your move?'; instead rep offers to email the estimate and tells customer to 'reply to that email or give us a call' — no direct ask for the business
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Only email address (DC Sarah HT @gmail.com) confirmed; no date confirmation, phone number confirmation, arrival window, crew size, or move-day addresses re-confirmed in a booking context — rep treats the call as an estimate delivery only

top_strength: Jeline gathered comprehensive logistics details and painted a clear, well-personalized estimate anchored to the customer's home size, floor count, special items (large TVs), and traffic/access complexity—showing strong discovery and pricing transparency.
coaching_note: This call stalled before closing: skip Section 2's concerns-gathering entirely, skip all Three Promises language, never ask 'does that feel fair?' to pause for buyer reaction, and end with 'I'll email it' instead of an explicit 'would you like our help?' — the whole latter half of the call needs to move from estimate delivery to actual close attempt.
